func (s *Server) processIncomingTelegramCommand(ctx context.Context, explicitTaskKey, text, chatID, fromUser string, stepDelay time.Duration) (string, error) {
	cleanText := strings.TrimSpace(text)
	lower := strings.ToLower(cleanText)
	isApprove := strings.Contains(lower, "approve") ||
		strings.Contains(lower, "/approve") ||
		strings.Contains(lower, "duyệt") ||
		strings.Contains(lower, "duyet") ||
		strings.Contains(lower, "ok chạy") ||
		strings.Contains(lower, "chạy đi") ||
		lower == "ok" ||
		lower == "chạy" ||
		lower == "chay" ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "ok ") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "chạy ") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "chay ")
	if !isApprove {
		s.appendTelegramEvent("INBOUND_MSG", explicitTaskKey, fmt.Sprintf("@%s: %s (ignored — not an APPROVE command)", fromUser, cleanText), "IGNORED")
		return "", fmt.Errorf("telegram message does not contain APPROVE command: %q", cleanText)
	}
